description: This file defines the CameraHandler class which manages camera operations such as listing devices, taking snapshots, and recording clips in an Android application. It includes functions for handling camera interactions, error handling, and JSON serialization of device data.

classes.name: CameraHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing camera operations such as listing devices, capturing snapshots, and recording video clips in an Android application. It interacts with camera hardware, updates UI elements, and handles errors.

methods.name: handleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of camera devices and returns this information as a JSON payload encapsulated in an InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleSnap
methods.description: Initiates a camera snapshot, manages camera flash, logs the process, and returns the captured photo as a base64-encoded JSON payload.

methods.name: handleClip
methods.description: Records a video clip from the camera, checks payload size, encodes the clip in base64, and returns it within a JSON payload.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses the 'includeAudio' parameter from JSON input to determine if audio should be recorded with the clip.
